children: Organigram received a Nasdaq notice after its closing bid price stayed below US$1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. It has until May 10, 2027, to regain compliance; its TSX listing is unaffected.
Must regain $1.00 bid price by May 10, 2027
Failure to meet the threshold could lead to delisting proceedings; Nasdaq's notice has no immediate effect on trading.
Bid price below $1.00 for 30 business days
The sustained shortfall triggered the listing deficiency and leaves the share price below Nasdaq's continued-listing threshold.
An extension is conditional on meeting Nasdaq requirements, including transferring the listing to the Nasdaq Capital Market.
TSX listing and compliance status unaffected
The Nasdaq notice does not affect the company's Toronto listing.

This is a compliance warning following 30 consecutive business days below Nasdaq's minimum bid price, not an immediate delisting. The next catalyst is whether Organigram regains the $1.00 threshold by May 10, 2027, or qualifies for an additional compliance period.
